sloka: ततः कार्य समासंगम् अवगम्य हनूमति ।विदित्वा हनुमन्तम् च चिन्तयामास राघवः ॥४-४४-८॥
transliteration: tataḥ kārya samāsaṁgam avagamya hanūmati ।viditvā hanumantam ca cintayāmāsa rāghavaḥ ॥4-44-8॥

translations.english: Having understood that Hanuman was capable of accomplishing the goal, Rama started reflecting as follows:
